name: Rummy 500
tagline: Meld from the pile, lay off on anyone's melds, and race to 500.
rulesSummary: Deal 7 cards each (13 with two players). Each turn, draw from the stock — or take any card from the discard pile along with every card on top of it.
If you take more than the top card, you must meld the deepest one this turn.
Meld sets (3–4 of a rank) and runs (3+ in a suit; ace high or low, not both), and lay off on anyone's melds. Then discard.
Cards you meld or lay off score for you: aces 15 (1 in A-2-3), faces 10, others their number. When someone goes out, cards left in hand count against you.
First past 500 wins. Two decks are used for five or six players. Played without jokers.
